facts.fact: The article names Tunisia's National Digital Strategy 2021-2025 as a five-year plan; its stated period had ended by the article's date, and the article gives no successor strategy by name (only a 'broader national vision for 2026-2030'); the as-at date is the article's publication date (2026-03-09). Text public: not stated

The article says the Digital Strategy 2021-2025 'translated vision into delivery', citing by 2025 nearly 80% of the population as internet users and 4G coverage near 95%, measured against no target of the strategy itself and with no published progress report named.
